intro: One playthrough, about 200 hours (PowerPyx) to 250+ (Push Square). No difficulty settings, no mission replay, no online trophies — and only one trophy that can possibly go wrong. Work the stages in order and the platinum follows.

stages.name: Prep & Chapter 1
stages.note: Set the run up right. Everything in this stage protects the one missable trophy and starts the long counters early.

tasks.detail: Turn on progress notifications: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On, so you can see every action that counts.
tasks.text: Turn cheats OFF and leave them off — cheats disable trophies and stop the game saving.

tasks.detail: Save plan: 15 manual slots + 1 autosave. Keep one save at the start and one at the end of every chapter; rotate the other 5 during free-roam cleanup.
tasks.text: Keep 10 manual saves: one at the start and one at the end of each chapter. With no mission replay, chapter saves are your only safety net.

tasks.detail: Chapter 1 meditation: the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
tasks.text: Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 (see Positive Mental Attitude) — the only possibly missable step in the game.

tasks.detail: Play Chapter 1: Gone Fishing, then Island Dreams (Kenton's strand opens — take it).
tasks.text: Finish the first mission, Gone Fishing, and the story trophies start popping on their own.

tasks.detail: Start the long counters: scan every new vehicle (200 of 277 needed) and study every new animal (100 of 255 needed). Both count from the first hour.
tasks.text: Start scanning vehicles with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1) and studying animals through the binoculars (L1 wheel, zoom Up, hold R1).

tasks.detail: Arcade games at home: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind — finish all levels of any one.
tasks.text: Try one arcade game at the TV at home and finish its levels (Stick Fiddler).

tasks.detail: Cal's fishing strand: after Feng Shui he texts a fishing spot (purple icon). Beat him in the fishing challenge.
tasks.text: Meet Cal in Feng Shui, then follow his fishing texts (Baited My Tackle).

tasks.detail: End Chapter 1: finish the chapter missions, then start What's in the Bag? in Chapter 2.
tasks.text: Finish Chapter 1 and start Chapter 2 — Paradise Lost pops early in Chapter 2.

stages.name: Story — Chapters 2–4
stages.note: The story is the spine of the run. Every system that matters opens in these chapters; start each strand when it appears and the work spreads itself out.

tasks.detail: Coffee Break: after it you can switch between Jason and Lucia and roam together. Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best all need this.
tasks.text: Unlock partner play with Coffee Break (Chapter 2) — every partner trophy needs it.

tasks.detail: Billy's strand (Thrillbilly Mudclub, Kelly County) and the Scooter Bros + Vice City Real Estate apps both open in Chapter 2.
tasks.text: Start Billy's strand at the Thrillbilly Mudclub and Moses' garage app (Daily Driver).

tasks.detail: Andy's 5 quests (Lucia only): Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
tasks.text: Do Andy's strand as Lucia (Chapter 3, phone call then Belville address).

tasks.detail: Tyrone's strand (Jason only): destroy the Synthetic Labs (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Spin On This.
tasks.text: Do Tyrone's labs as Jason (Chapter 3, after Here, Kitty Kitty).

tasks.detail: Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS: the Zorrusso delivery is the first of Randy's 16 cars, and the Key Cloner it unlocks is required for Capital Offense.
tasks.text: Steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner (Chapter 3).

tasks.detail: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun (Sneakthief) and marks jewelry stores (green icons).
tasks.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies (Chapter 3).

tasks.detail: Randy's 16 cars: scan with WAiNK before stealing. Best hunting ground is Vice Beach / Ocean Beach in east Vice City.
tasks.text: Work Randy's wish list as you travel — scan sports cars with WAiNK to check them.

tasks.detail: Meditations: each outdoor spot counts twice with both characters. The Mount Kalaga stone circle appears only after the other nine.
tasks.text: Meditate at every spot you pass, with both characters (10 spots, 18 meditations).

tasks.detail: That's Where The Money Is… (Chapter 4): tail the security van, rob the vault. This opens Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together.
tasks.text: Take the bank-vault introduction mission when it is marked (Chapter 4).

tasks.detail: End Chapter 4: Starting From Zero. Save before it and after it — the endgame starts right after.
tasks.text: Finish Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero) and keep a save before the final mission.

stages.name: Final chapter & the 100% checklist
stages.note: The story ends and the checklist opens. The checklist is lenient — near 60% true completion — but it is the biggest single block of the run.

tasks.detail: Final mission (Chapter 5): You Gotta Know When to Get Off pops at the end. Free-roam continues after the credits.
tasks.text: Finish the final mission (Chapter 5) and the gold for it.

tasks.detail: The checklist unlocks after the story. Everything done during the story already counts — nothing on it is missable.
tasks.text: Open the checklist: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.

tasks.detail: Optional missions: any 100 count. Purple icons and black icons with pink letters; main missions are pink icons with black letters.
tasks.text: Complete any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+).

tasks.detail: Vehicles: scan any 200 base models, including boats and aircraft. Whip It Good (100) comes on the way.
tasks.text: Scan 200 of 277 base vehicles with WAiNK.

tasks.detail: Animals: study any 100 through the binoculars. Every breed of dog and cat counts separately; no hunting needed.
tasks.text: Study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars.

tasks.detail: Stunts: any 300 of 397. Under the Bridges (202) are the quickest; Stunt Jumps 130, Knife Flights 40, Base Jumps 25.
tasks.text: Complete 300 stunts (Cunning Stunts needs 250).

tasks.detail: Challenges: any 70 of 80. Pick the easiest 10 to skip — the list shows a Completed checkmark on each.
tasks.text: Complete 70 of 80 challenges (One Last Thing needs 50).

tasks.detail: Meditations 15/18 and card sets 15/18 are the partial rows. The full rows (robberies, underwater, ranges, drone races, Bret's decks) are in Stage 4.
tasks.text: Do 15 of 18 meditations and 15 of 18 card sets.

stages.name: Robberies, collectibles & activities
stages.note: The all-or-nothing rows and the big counters. Work region by region instead of criss-crossing Leonida.

tasks.detail: Bank vaults: 8 total, up to $205,000 each. Pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (purple icons) after his Payday Loans quests.
tasks.text: Rob all 8 large bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal needs 5).

tasks.detail: Gang operations: 39 total across 9 gangs. Yellow icons when near; track per gang under Progress > Gangs.
tasks.text: Rob all 39 Illegal Operations, one per gang at least (Pest Control).

tasks.detail: Bret's Target Decks: 15 total, Jason only, from Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Clearing all 15 should cover Fair Game's unconfirmed animal.
tasks.text: Clear all 15 of Bret's Target Decks (Fair Game).

tasks.detail: Card sets: 15 of 18 for 100%. Found cards stay marked on the map, so the gaps are easy to spot.
tasks.text: Complete 15 of 18 collectible card sets (Don't Touch My Deck needs 3).

tasks.detail: Shooting ranges: 12 locations, 42 golds. Gold is accuracy plus rhythm — slow first shot, then keep pace.
tasks.text: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist).

tasks.detail: Races: 14 drone locations (42 races) and 40 unique race locations. Drone wins count toward both Top Fun and Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
tasks.text: Win drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations and 20 different races total.

tasks.detail: WAiNK scans (100) and vehicles (100 discovered) share the same app — scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and every vehicle you pass.
tasks.text: Scan 100 WAiNK locations and discover 100 vehicles.

tasks.detail: Garages + registrations: buy the 8 through Vice City Real Estate, then register cheap stolen cars and bikes with Moses in Port Gellhorn.
tasks.text: Buy all 8 garages ($160,000) and register 10 vehicles with Scooter Bros.

tasks.detail: Money: Dime on the Dollar (fence marked bills with Yasmani — he pays most) and Treat Yo Self (guns, mods and tattoos are fastest).
tasks.text: Launder $250,000 in marked bills and spend $100,000 in shops.

stages.name: Strangers, Freaks & the platinum
stages.note: The last strands and the last unknowns. Nothing here is missable — it is all free-roam cleanup.

tasks.detail: Strangers & Freaks: 8 confirmed strands. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count — pick from Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
tasks.text: Complete 8 stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete confirmed).

tasks.detail: Unconfirmed: Bad Luck, I Guess (believed Payday Loans, Prologue) and Ten Pin (believed motorcycle melee kick). Do not grind them blind — check for a confirmed method first.
tasks.text: Check the two unconfirmed trophies (Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin) against the Sources page.

tasks.detail: Personal Best: work out at fitness clubs with your partner. While one trains, the other trains automatically.
tasks.text: Max out strength on both characters together (Personal Best).

tasks.detail: Verified since launch: the UFO north-west of Starlet Motel after 2AM (solo, blinking car) and the Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
tasks.text: Finish the UFO event (The Truth Is Out There) and the Ocean Beach cocktail (In The Beginning…).

tasks.detail: Platinum: when the 100% checklist completes, A Long Road pops — and Vice Got a Price! follows with it.
tasks.text: Watch A Long Road pop, then the platinum.
